title: Online learning
description:
ONLINE CLASSES

All online classes are on Eastern Time Zone (ET) unless stated otherwise.

Questions? Email us via info@penumbrafoundation.org or call us at 917-288–0343

If your desired tuition option says “Sold Out” please contact us and we will do our best to accommodate you. If the entire class is sold out, we can add you to the waitlist.

Penumbra is unable to offer scholarships or financial aid.

Please review our education policies before registering!
seoDescription: Registration is available for upcoming online workshops with Penumbra

nodes.html:
Upcoming online classes are scheduled below. A minimum of three students is required for all online classes to run. In most cases, our registration deadline is 24 hrs prior to the start time of a class, unless the class does not reach the minimum number of students one week prior to the start date, in which case it will be canceled. All participants will need to have sufficient internet connectivity to participate in group and/or individual sessions online via zoom.

Before registering for a class, please review our Education & Refund Policies.
